### <a name="resolve_reference"></a>`resolve_reference`

Set config values by accessing secrets in Hashicorp Vault

**Supports noop?** false

#### Parameters

##### `server_url`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

The URL of the Vault server

##### `auth`

Data type: `Optional[Hash]`

The method for authorizing with the Vault server and any necessary parameters

##### `path`

Data type: `String[1]`

The path to the secrets engine

##### `field`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

The specific secret being used

##### `version`

Data type: `Optional[Numeric]`

The version of the K/V engine

##### `cacert`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Path to the CA certificate
